_comment: Benign: hand-written weather tool with enum, default and nested items.

tools.name: get_weather
tools.title: Get weather
tools.description:
Current conditions and an optional multi-day forecast for one city.

Use when: the user asks about weather for a named place.
Prefer another tool when: the user wants historical climate data.

city.description: City name, e.g. Lisbon or Osaka.

units.description: Unit system for temperatures and wind speed.

days.description: Forecast days to include; 0 for current conditions only.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Which measurements to return; all when omitted.
